headline: Botswana Secures $504 Million AfDB Loan to Buffer Energy Shocks
summary: The African Development Bank approved a $503.75 million (6.62 billion Botswana pula) loan facility for Botswana to cushion global energy supply shocks and support private sector structural reforms.
why: The financing represents one of the African Development Bank's largest credit operations in Botswana, helping the diamond-dependent nation diversify and strengthen public finances.

impacts.name: Botswana
impacts.why: A $504 million facility provides fiscal cushion against import energy inflation and backs growth initiatives.
